name: grounded-citation
description: Answer quality with a correct citation, measured where it can be measured today: hybrid retrieval returns the context, the chat model composes the answer as JSON {answer, citations:[chunk numbers]} (the step the bot's caller does), and a case passes only when the JSON parses, at least one cited chunk belongs to the expected document AND the answer states the expected fact. The server stays retrieval-only by design; the harness owns the composition.
